nodes.label: IoT Integration Plan v1 (Architecture Authority)
nodes.rationale: Authoritative planning draft for ESP32-to-app BLE integration; frozen as Plan v1; corrections only via Decision-Log entries citing superseded sections.

nodes.label: Section 1.4 Firmware Change Scope Constraint
nodes.rationale: Hard constraint: only BLE capability, NVS persistence and data transmission may change; hardware-control/operation code forever frozen; BLE added observationally via additive integration points in setup()/loop().

nodes.label: v3 Firmware Baseline Architecture
nodes.rationale: Monolithic non-blocking loop at ~15 ms: readSensorsAsync, calculateCompositeAQI, updateFan, updateLEDs, handleDisplayTransitions, updateDisplay, updateAndDrawParticles; peripherals: ST7789 TFT, PMS7003 UART2, BME680 I2C, WS2812B FastLED strip, ARCTIC P8 Max 4-pin PWM fan, battery ADC and charge pins.

nodes.label: pm10Value Naming Trap (holds PM1.0)
nodes.rationale: v3 variable pm10Value actually holds PM1.0 from data.pm10_env; no rename allowed under 1.4; BLE code must read the v3 name as-is and map it to payload key pm1.

nodes.label: Connectivity Options and Tradeoffs
nodes.rationale: Option A (BLE GATT server, custom service) chosen; NUS emulation acceptable spike only; WiFi/MQTT and dual-radio deferred; keeps MVP cloud-free.

nodes.label: NimBLE-Arduino Stack Choice
nodes.rationale: ~50% less flash/RAM than Bluedroid, core 3.x compatible, clean async callbacks; must be verified against the exact installed core minor.

nodes.label: JSON v1 Payload Encoding Decision
nodes.rationale: JSON + version field chosen as protocol v1 for debuggability and fast shipping; binary struct and CBOR deferred; version field mandatory as the only firmware-to-app upgrade path.

nodes.label: Filter Lifetime Tracking Model
nodes.rationale: Device stores raw data only, all analytics app-side: health% = 1 - pwfs/loadBudget capped by hours budget; decay-curve effectiveness estimate as insights feature only; intake-side sensing means effectiveness is estimated, not measured; budgets are app config (D-011).

nodes.label: NVS Raw Counter Persistence Design
nodes.rationale: Preferences namespace docasa, 5-min throttled writes, unsigned-delta millis() accumulation for the 49.7-day rollover, uint64 storage mandatory for the PM-weighted integral (overflow within days as u32).

nodes.label: Time Authority: Phone-Supplied Epoch
nodes.rationale: Device has no RTC and no wall clock; time command re-sent on every connect; device-side timestamps never trusted across reboots (risk 7.13); all history timestamps are app-side.

nodes.label: Flutter App Plan and Layering
nodes.rationale: BLE layer to protocol codec (JSON v1 to typed models) to repository (counters math, history DB) to state mgmt (Riverpod) to UI; repository testable without hardware; flutter_blue_plus + fl_chart + Drift; screens: dashboard, system, filter, connection manager.

nodes.label: Hurdle and Risk Master List (Plan section 7)
nodes.rationale: 17 risks: no persistence, millis rollover, flash wear, module variant, BLE stack budget, boot screen, cadence mismatch, write security, single central, VOC quality, no OTA, protocol evolution, time authority, BLE testing, reconnect robustness, filter-model assumptions, fan PWM (resolved in v3).

nodes.label: Phased Roadmap P0-P5
nodes.rationale: P0 persistence enablement, P1 BLE telemetry, P2 app MVP, P3 security + offline history, P4 WiFi/OTA/cloud, P5 hardware upgrade path (differential pressure or outlet PM sensor).

nodes.label: 4-Pin PWM Fan Rework (v3)
nodes.rationale: ARCTIC P8 Max fan: PWM 25 kHz per Intel 4-pin spec, inverse duty via transistor (255 = fan OFF); RPM targets 0/1000/2000/3000/4000; tach input deferred outside 1.4 scope (restricted list); currentFanRpm is a commanded target, not measured.

nodes.label: Requirement Traceability Matrix (Plan section 10)
nodes.rationale: All three required features achievable with present sensor set + 4-pin fan; no extra sensors needed; gaps are infrastructure (NVS, BLE, offline logging, time sync) and app work; honest caveats: VOC qualitative proxy, voltage-model battery %, load-weighted filter estimate.
